description: Kotlin is a language used for Android apps, server programs and small tools. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install a JDK and Kotlin. Save lesson.kt, run kotlinc lesson.kt -include-runtime -d lesson.jar, then java -jar lesson.jar.
versionNote: Examples use Kotlin 1.9 or later on the JVM.
whatYouWillLearn: Count with a range with Kotlin
